fullTextEN: I have a lot of snacks,
a lot of fruit.

fullTextZH: 爸爸妈妈把最好的东西都给我。
fullTextEN: My parents give me the best things.

fullTextZH: 我问爸爸妈妈：“为什么别人有哥哥姐姐，
fullTextEN: I asked my parents, 'Why do others have older brothers and sisters,
and I don't?' Do you know?

fullTextZH: 在中国，很多人家里只有一个孩子。
fullTextEN: In China, many families have only one child.
Like me.

fullTextZH: 我的爸爸妈妈只有我一个孩子。
fullTextEN: My parents have only one child, me.
I don't have older brothers or sisters,
younger brothers or sisters,
no siblings.
How many children are in your family?
Do you have an older brother?
Do you have an older sister?
Do you have a younger brother?
Do you have a younger sister?
When I was little,

fullTextZH: 爸爸妈妈工作很忙很忙，
fullTextEN: my parents were very, very busy with work,

fullTextZH: 所以我和爷爷奶奶住在一起。
fullTextEN: so I lived with my grandparents.
I could only go home on weekends,

fullTextZH: 和爸爸妈妈在一起只有两天。
fullTextEN: Only two days with mom and dad.
I am very happy,
The time is too short.
At home, I am alone.
No older brother,
No older sister,
No younger brother,
No younger sister.
Who do I talk to?
I talk to my doll,
I talk to the mirror.
Because no one chats with me.
But I have a lot of snacks,
A lot of fruit,
No one fights with me for them.

fullTextZH: 爸爸妈妈把最好的东西都给我。
fullTextEN: Mom and dad give me the best things.

fullTextZH: 我问爸爸妈妈：“为什么别人有哥哥姐姐，
fullTextEN: I asked mom and dad: "Why do others have older brothers and sisters,
and I don't?" Now I know,

fullTextZH: 那是因为我的爸爸在政府工作。
fullTextEN: It's because my dad works in the government.
30 years ago,
The Chinese government says:
"If you live in the city,
you can only have one child."
Only one is allowed.
If you want to have two children,

fullTextZH: 爸爸妈妈的工作就没有了。
fullTextEN: the parents' jobs will be gone.
It's scary, isn't it?

fullTextZH: 后来，我的妈妈又怀孕了，
fullTextEN: Later, my mom got pregnant again,
there was a baby in her belly.

fullTextZH: 但是他们不可以要这个孩子。
fullTextEN: But they couldn't have this child.

fullTextZH: 所以我没有哥哥姐姐弟弟妹妹，
fullTextEN: So I have no brothers or sisters,
no siblings.

fullTextZH: 小学的时候，我和爸爸妈妈一起住。
fullTextEN: In elementary school, I lived with my parents.

fullTextZH: 每天，我一个人一个人去学校。
fullTextEN: Every day, I went to school alone.
I went to school alone,
no one took me to school.
At noon, I ate alone,

fullTextZH: 下午我一个人再去学校。
fullTextEN: in the afternoon, I went to school alone again.

fullTextZH: 你觉得我一个人孤独吗？孤独。
fullTextEN: Do you think I was lonely alone? Lonely.

fullTextZH: 但是，我会自己和自己说话。
fullTextEN: But, I would talk to myself.
Sometimes, I am the dad.
I speak with dad's voice.
Sometimes, I am the mom.
I speak with mom's voice.
Sometimes, I am someone else.

fullTextZH: 我用别的人的声音说话。
fullTextEN: I speak with someone else's voice.

fullTextZH: 我喜欢偷偷地用妈妈的化妆品，
fullTextEN: I like to secretly use mom's makeup,
wear mom's high heels.

fullTextZH: 你小时候也和我一样吗？
fullTextEN: When you were little, were you like me?
My mom is very busy,
has no time to be with me,
has no time to play with me.
When not going to school,
she leaves me alone at home.
She says: 'It's dangerous outside,

fullTextZH: 有坏人。”所以我一个人在家。
fullTextEN: there are bad people.' So I stay home alone.
I do many, many things myself.
After mom comes home,

fullTextZH: 她觉得我一个人在家是一个好孩子，
fullTextEN: she thinks I'm a good kid for staying home alone,
so she gives me an ice cream.
Watch TV for an hour.
I like to eat ice cream.
I like watching TV.

fullTextZH: 所以妈妈没有时间和我一起玩，
fullTextEN: So mom doesn't have time to play with me,
I think it's no problem.

fullTextZH: 因为我有冰淇淋和电视啊！
fullTextEN: Because I have ice cream and TV!

fullTextZH: 那我的妈妈只给我冰淇淋，
fullTextEN: Then my mom only gives me ice cream,
and lets me watch TV?
And other things.
If I make noise while eating,

fullTextZH: 然后妈妈就会打我的手。
fullTextEN: then mom will hit my hand.

fullTextZH: 因为妈妈觉得，吃饭的时候，
fullTextEN: Because mom thinks that while eating,

fullTextZH: 很大的声音是不礼貌的。
fullTextEN: loud noises are impolite.
If I... um, cry,
then I can't eat.
And then?
My dad is different.

fullTextZH: 我的爸爸会偷偷地带我去吃肯德基。
fullTextEN: My dad would secretly take me to eat KFC.
Later, when I grew up,
I often went to my good friend's house to play.

fullTextZH: 有时候会住在她家，一起睡觉。
fullTextEN: Sometimes I stay at her house and we sleep together.

fullTextZH: 我们会说很多很多的东西。
fullTextEN: We talk about many, many things.
My good friend's parents,
I call them uncle and aunt.
They make a lot of delicious food.
I am so happy!
A good friend is like my sister.

fullTextZH: 我很喜欢和朋友在一起。
fullTextEN: I really like being with friends.

fullTextZH: 你呢？你小时候的生活是什么样的？
fullTextEN: What about you? What was your childhood like?
Do you have siblings?
Leave a comment and tell me.
